name: release-root-capture
purpose: Drive the pinned release ROM from cold boot to its first real battle via set_keys, then save_state the battle root and pin its sha256 (the 528448-byte blob is never committed).

steps.note: cold boot through the intro movie to the title screen (cb2 0x08155bdd)
main menu settles on NEW GAME
speech plays; cb2 0x081855a5 seen at forward frame 2692
cb2 settles on 0x08188e15 at forward frame 4036
mash A through the remaining text/gender/naming flow; ends in the 0x08188e15 <-> 0x0815b181 callback loop with no battle

resume_hint.note: The script above is what was actually verified through wave 2; it reaches the gender/naming callback loop (0x08188e15 <-> 0x0815b181) and does not enter a battle. The remaining steps (name entry confirm, starter choice, Route 101 walk, wild encounter) are NOT yet scripted.
resume_hint.observed_probe: work/w2_rel_drive.log (200k frames of scripted input, gBattleTypeFlags stayed 0)

release_evidence.artifact_identity: pinned release ROM and worker hashes verified
release_evidence.detail: The 15,528-frame cold-boot input sequence did not reach a battle. The naming callback appears, but subsequent A presses return to the main-menu callback and the full sequence ends in CB2_Overworld with no party or battle flags. The saved warp bytes encode group 25/map 40; no battle-root state was captured. No compatible release save or savestate is present in the local repository, worktrees, or pinned source checkouts.
